CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW sasi.bronze_cclf_test.d0284_cclf_claim_header_view AS
WITH max_batch_cclf1 AS (
  SELECT max(cast(batch_id AS bigint)) AS max_batch_id
  FROM sasi.bronze_cclf_test.d0284_cclf1_v1
),
max_batch_cclf5 AS (
  SELECT max(cast(batch_id AS bigint)) AS max_batch_id
  FROM sasi.bronze_cclf_test.d0284_cclf5_v1
),
max_batch_cclf6 AS (
  SELECT max(cast(batch_id AS bigint)) AS max_batch_id
  FROM sasi.bronze_cclf_test.d0284_cclf6_v1
),
cclf1_header AS (
  SELECT
    c1.batch_id                                                             AS batch_id,
    CAST(c1.CUR_CLM_UNIQ_ID AS STRING)                                      AS source_claim_id,
    CASE WHEN TRIM(c1.CLM_TYPE_CD) = '60' THEN 'IP'
         WHEN TRIM(c1.CLM_TYPE_CD) IN ('10','20','30','40','50') THEN 'OP'
         WHEN TRIM(c1.CLM_TYPE_CD) IN ('71','72','81','82') THEN 'PROF'
         ELSE NULL
    END                                                                     AS claim_type,
    CAST(NULL AS STRING)                                                    AS source_resource_id,
    CAST(NULL AS STRING)                                                    AS source_resource_type,
    'X12_837I'                                                              AS source_format,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(c1.BENE_MBI_ID), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(c1.BENE_HIC_NUM), '')) AS patient_id,
    CAST(NULL AS STRING)                                                    AS source_billing_org_id,
    CAST(NULL AS STRING)                                                    AS source_rendering_org_id,
    CASE WHEN TRIM(c1.CLM_TYPE_CD) IN ('10', '71', '72', '81', '82') THEN CAST(c1.CLM_THRU_DT AS DATE)
         ELSE NULL
    END                                                                     AS discharge_date,
    CAST(c1.CLM_FROM_DT AS DATE)                                            AS statement_from,
    CAST(c1.CLM_THRU_DT AS DATE)                                            AS statement_through,
    CAST(NULL AS DATE)                                                      AS paid_date,
    CAST(c1.CLM_EFCTV_DT AS DATE)                                           AS claim_effective_date,
    CAST(c1.CLM_IDR_LD_DT AS DATE)                                          AS claim_received_date,
    CAST(NULL AS INT)                                                       AS claim_version_num,
    NULLIF(TRIM(c1.CLM_ORG_CNTL_NUM), '')                                   AS adjusted_claim_id,
    CASE WHEN TRIM(c1.CLM_TYPE_CD) IN ('10', '71', '72', '81', '82', '20', '30', '50', '60')
         THEN NULLIF(TRIM(c1.DGNS_DRG_CD), '')
         ELSE NULL
    END                                                                     AS drg_code,
    CASE WHEN TRIM(c1.CLM_TYPE_CD) IN ('10', '71', '72', '81', '82', '20', '30', '50', '60')
              AND NULLIF(TRIM(c1.DGNS_DRG_CD), '') IS NOT NULL
         THEN 'MS-DRG' ELSE NULL
    END                                                                     AS drg_code_system,
    CASE WHEN NULLIF(TRIM(c1.CLM_BILL_FAC_TYPE_CD), '') IS NULL
              AND NULLIF(TRIM(c1.CLM_BILL_CLSFCTN_CD), '') IS NULL
              AND NULLIF(TRIM(c1.CLM_BILL_FREQ_CD), '') IS NULL THEN NULL
         ELSE CONCAT(
                COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(c1.CLM_BILL_FAC_TYPE_CD), ''), ''),
                COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(c1.CLM_BILL_CLSFCTN_CD), ''), ''),
                COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(c1.CLM_BILL_FREQ_CD), ''), '')
              )
    END                                                                     AS bill_type,
    CASE WHEN TRIM(c1.CLM_TYPE_CD) IN ('10', '71', '72', '81', '82')
         THEN NULLIF(TRIM(c1.CLM_ADMSN_TYPE_CD), '')
         ELSE NULL
    END                                                                     AS admission_type,
    CASE WHEN TRIM(c1.CLM_TYPE_CD) IN ('10', '71', '72', '81', '82')
         THEN NULLIF(TRIM(c1.CLM_ADMSN_SRC_CD), '')
         ELSE NULL
    END                                                                     AS admission_source,
    NULLIF(TRIM(c1.BENE_PTNT_STUS_CD), '')                                  AS discharge_status,
    NULLIF(TRIM(c1.CLM_ADJSMT_TYPE_CD), '')                                 AS claim_adjustment_type_cd,
    CAST(NULL AS STRING)                                                    AS claim_status,
    CAST(NULL AS STRING)                                                    AS reason_for_visit,
    CAST(NULL AS STRING)                                                    AS actual_length_of_stay,
    CAST(NULL AS STRING)                                                    AS covered_length_of_stay,
    CAST(NULL AS STRING)                                                    AS line_of_business,
    CAST(NULL AS STRING)                                                    AS product,
    CAST(NULL AS STRING)                                                    AS primary_payer,
    NULLIF(TRIM(c1.CLM_TYPE_CD), '')                                         AS CLM_TYPE_CD,
    NULLIF(TRIM(c1.CLM_OP_SRVC_TYPE_CD), '')                                AS CLM_OP_SRVC_TYPE_CD,
    NULLIF(TRIM(c1.DGNS_PRCDR_ICD_IND), '')                                 AS DGNS_PRCDR_ICD_IND,
    CAST(NULL AS STRING)                                                    AS CLM_PRCSG_IND_CD,
    CAST(NULL AS STRING)                                                    AS CLM_CNTL_NUM,
    CAST(NULL AS STRING)                                                    AS CLM_CNTRCTR_NUM,
    CAST(NULL AS STRING)                                                    AS CLM_DISP_CD,
    cast(1 AS int)                                                          AS source_priority
  FROM sasi.bronze_cclf_test.d0284_cclf1_v1 c1
  INNER JOIN max_batch_cclf1 mb
    ON cast(c1.batch_id AS bigint) = mb.max_batch_id
  WHERE NULLIF(TRIM(c1.CUR_CLM_UNIQ_ID), '') IS NOT NULL
),

  FROM cclf5_lines l

    CAST(c6.CLM_EFCTV_DT AS DATE)                                           AS claim_effective_date,

    NULLIF(TRIM(c6.CLM_DISP_CD), '')                                        AS CLM_DISP_CD
  FROM sasi.bronze_cclf_test.d0284_cclf6_v1 c6
  INNER JOIN max_batch_cclf6 mb

),
cclf5_line AS (

    CAST(NULLIF(TRIM(c5.CLM_LINE_NUM), '~') AS INT)                          AS line_number,

    CAST(NULLIF(TRIM(c5.CLM_LINE_SRVC_UNIT_QTY), '~') AS DECIMAL(18,4))      AS billed_units,

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW sasi.bronze_cclf_test.d0284_cclf_claim_diagnosis_view AS
WITH max_batch_cclf4 AS (
  SELECT max(cast(batch_id AS bigint)) AS max_batch_id
  FROM sasi.bronze_cclf_test.d0284_cclf4_v1
),
max_batch_cclf1 AS (
  SELECT max(cast(batch_id AS bigint)) AS max_batch_id
  FROM sasi.bronze_cclf_test.d0284_cclf1_v1
),
max_batch_cclf5 AS (
  SELECT max(cast(batch_id AS bigint)) AS max_batch_id
  FROM sasi.bronze_cclf_test.d0284_cclf5_v1
),
cclf1_hdr AS (
  SELECT
    cast(c.batch_id AS bigint)                                              AS batch_id,
    c.ingest_ts                                                             AS ingest_ts,
    nullif(trim(c.CUR_CLM_UNIQ_ID), '~')                                    AS source_claim_id,
    nullif(trim(c.PRNCPL_DGNS_CD), '~')                                     AS prncpl_dgns_cd,
    nullif(trim(c.ADMTG_DGNS_CD), '~')                                      AS admtg_dgns_cd,
    nullif(trim(c.DGNS_PRCDR_ICD_IND), '~')                                 AS dgns_prcdr_icd_ind
  FROM sasi.bronze_cclf_test.d0284_cclf1_v1 c
  INNER JOIN max_batch_cclf1 mb
    ON cast(c.batch_id AS bigint) = mb.max_batch_id
  WHERE nullif(trim(c.CUR_CLM_UNIQ_ID), '~') IS NOT NULL
),
cclf4_diag AS (
  SELECT
    cast(d.batch_id AS bigint)                                              AS batch_id,
    d.ingest_ts                                                             AS ingest_ts,
    nullif(trim(d.CUR_CLM_UNIQ_ID), '~')                                    AS source_claim_id,
    cast(d.CLM_VAL_SQNC_NUM AS int)                                         AS diagnosis_sequence,
    nullif(trim(d.CLM_DGNS_CD), '~')                                        AS source_diagnosis_code,
    CASE nullif(trim(coalesce(d.DGNS_PRCDR_ICD_IND, 'U')), '~')
      WHEN '9' THEN 'http://hl7.org/fhir/sid/icd-9-cm'
      WHEN '0' THEN 'http://hl7.org/fhir/sid/icd-10-cm'
      ELSE 'UNKNOWN'
    END                                                                     AS source_diagnosis_code_system,
    CASE
      WHEN nullif(trim(d.CLM_DGNS_CD), '~') = h.prncpl_dgns_cd
        THEN 'principal'
      WHEN nullif(trim(d.CLM_DGNS_CD), '~') = h.admtg_dgns_cd
        THEN 'admitting'
      WHEN nullif(trim(d.CLM_PROD_TYPE_CD), '~') IN ('E', '1')
        THEN 'external cause'
      ELSE 'secondary'
    END                                                                     AS diagnosis_type,
    nullif(trim(d.CLM_POA_IND), '~')                                        AS poa_flag,
    nullif(trim(d.CLM_PROD_TYPE_CD), '~')                                   AS CLM_PROD_TYPE_CD,
    cast(1 AS int)                                                          AS source_priority
  FROM sasi.bronze_cclf_test.d0284_cclf4_v1 d
  INNER JOIN max_batch_cclf4 mb
    ON cast(d.batch_id AS bigint) = mb.max_batch_id
  LEFT JOIN cclf1_hdr h
    ON nullif(trim(d.CUR_CLM_UNIQ_ID), '~') = h.source_claim_id
  WHERE nullif(trim(d.CUR_CLM_UNIQ_ID), '~') IS NOT NULL
    AND d.CLM_VAL_SQNC_NUM IS NOT NULL
    AND nullif(trim(d.CLM_DGNS_CD), '~') IS NOT NULL
),
cclf1_principal AS (
  SELECT
    h.batch_id,
    h.ingest_ts,
    h.source_claim_id,
    cast(1 AS int)                                                          AS diagnosis_sequence,
    h.prncpl_dgns_cd                                                        AS source_diagnosis_code,
    CASE nullif(trim(coalesce(h.dgns_prcdr_icd_ind, 'U')), '~')
      WHEN '9' THEN 'http://hl7.org/fhir/sid/icd-9-cm'
      WHEN '0' THEN 'http://hl7.org/fhir/sid/icd-10-cm'
      ELSE 'UNKNOWN'
    END                                                                     AS source_diagnosis_code_system,
    'principal'                                                             AS diagnosis_type,
    cast(null AS string)                                                    AS poa_flag,
    cast(null AS string)                                                    AS CLM_PROD_TYPE_CD,
    cast(2 AS int)                                                          AS source_priority
  FROM cclf1_hdr h
  WHERE h.prncpl_dgns_cd IS NOT NULL
    AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM cclf4_diag d4
      WHERE d4.source_claim_id = h.source_claim_id
        AND d4.source_diagnosis_code = h.prncpl_dgns_cd
    )
),
cclf1_admitting AS (
  SELECT
    h.batch_id,
    h.ingest_ts,
    h.source_claim_id,
    cast(0 AS int)                                                          AS diagnosis_sequence,
    h.admtg_dgns_cd                                                         AS source_diagnosis_code,
    CASE nullif(trim(coalesce(h.dgns_prcdr_icd_ind, 'U')), '~')
      WHEN '9' THEN 'http://hl7.org/fhir/sid/icd-9-cm'
      WHEN '0' THEN 'http://hl7.org/fhir/sid/icd-10-cm'
      ELSE 'UNKNOWN'
    END                                                                     AS source_diagnosis_code_system,
    'admitting'                                                             AS diagnosis_type,
    cast(null AS string)                                                    AS poa_flag,
    cast(null AS string)                                                    AS CLM_PROD_TYPE_CD,
    cast(2 AS int)                                                          AS source_priority
  FROM cclf1_hdr h
  WHERE h.admtg_dgns_cd IS NOT NULL
    AND h.admtg_dgns_cd <> coalesce(h.prncpl_dgns_cd, '')
    AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM cclf4_diag d4
      WHERE d4.source_claim_id = h.source_claim_id
        AND d4.source_diagnosis_code = h.admtg_dgns_cd
    )
),
cclf5_unpivot AS (
  SELECT
    cast(c.batch_id AS bigint)                                              AS batch_id,
    c.ingest_ts                                                             AS ingest_ts,
    nullif(trim(c.CUR_CLM_UNIQ_ID), '~')                                    AS source_claim_id,
    cast(dx_tbl.diagnosis_sequence AS int)                                  AS diagnosis_sequence,
    nullif(trim(dx_tbl.source_diagnosis_code), '~')                         AS source_diagnosis_code,
    CASE nullif(trim(coalesce(c.DGNS_PRCDR_ICD_IND, 'U')), '~')
      WHEN '9' THEN 'http://hl7.org/fhir/sid/icd-9-cm'
      WHEN '0' THEN 'http://hl7.org/fhir/sid/icd-10-cm'
      ELSE 'UNKNOWN'
    END                                                                     AS source_diagnosis_code_system,
    CASE
      WHEN cast(dx_tbl.diagnosis_sequence AS int) = 1 THEN 'principal'
      ELSE 'secondary'
    END                                                                     AS diagnosis_type,
    cast(null AS string)                                                    AS poa_flag,
    cast(null AS string)                                                    AS CLM_PROD_TYPE_CD,
    cast(c.CLM_LINE_NUM AS string)                                          AS _line_num_for_dedupe,
    cast(1 AS int)                                                          AS source_priority
  FROM sasi.bronze_cclf_test.d0284_cclf5_v1 c
  INNER JOIN max_batch_cclf5 mb
    ON cast(c.batch_id AS bigint) = mb.max_batch_id
  LATERAL VIEW stack(
    12,
    1,  nullif(trim(c.CLM_DGNS_1_CD),  '~'),
    2,  nullif(trim(c.CLM_DGNS_2_CD),  '~'),
    3,  nullif(trim(c.CLM_DGNS_3_CD),  '~'),
    4,  nullif(trim(c.CLM_DGNS_4_CD),  '~'),
    5,  nullif(trim(c.CLM_DGNS_5_CD),  '~'),
    6,  nullif(trim(c.CLM_DGNS_6_CD),  '~'),
    7,  nullif(trim(c.CLM_DGNS_7_CD),  '~'),
    8,  nullif(trim(c.CLM_DGNS_8_CD),  '~'),
    9,  nullif(trim(c.CLM_DGNS_9_CD),  '~'),
    10, nullif(trim(c.CLM_DGNS_10_CD), '~'),
    11, nullif(trim(c.CLM_DGNS_11_CD), '~'),
    12, nullif(trim(c.CLM_DGNS_12_CD), '~')
  ) dx_tbl AS diagnosis_sequence, source_diagnosis_code
  WHERE nullif(trim(c.CUR_CLM_UNIQ_ID), '~') IS NOT NULL
    AND nullif(trim(dx_tbl.source_diagnosis_code), '~') IS NOT NULL
),
cclf5_diag AS (
  SELECT
    batch_id,
    ingest_ts,
    source_claim_id,
    diagnosis_sequence,
    source_diagnosis_code,
    source_diagnosis_code_system,
    diagnosis_type,
    poa_flag,
    CLM_PROD_TYPE_CD,
    source_priority
  FROM (
    SELECT
      u.*,
      row_number() OVER (
        PARTITION BY u.source_claim_id, u.diagnosis_sequence, u.source_diagnosis_code
        ORDER BY u._line_num_for_dedupe
      ) AS rn
    FROM cclf5_unpivot u
  ) x
  WHERE rn = 1
),
unioned AS (
  SELECT
    batch_id, ingest_ts, source_claim_id, diagnosis_sequence,
    source_diagnosis_code, source_diagnosis_code_system,
    diagnosis_type, poa_flag, CLM_PROD_TYPE_CD, source_priority
  FROM cclf4_diag
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    batch_id, ingest_ts, source_claim_id, diagnosis_sequence,
    source_diagnosis_code, source_diagnosis_code_system,
    diagnosis_type, poa_flag, CLM_PROD_TYPE_CD, source_priority
  FROM cclf1_principal
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    batch_id, ingest_ts, source_claim_id, diagnosis_sequence,
    source_diagnosis_code, source_diagnosis_code_system,
    diagnosis_type, poa_flag, CLM_PROD_TYPE_CD, source_priority
  FROM cclf1_admitting
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    batch_id, ingest_ts, source_claim_id, diagnosis_sequence,
    source_diagnosis_code, source_diagnosis_code_system,
    diagnosis_type, poa_flag, CLM_PROD_TYPE_CD, source_priority
  FROM cclf5_diag
),
deduped AS (
  SELECT
    u.*,
    row_number() OVER (
      PARTITION BY u.source_claim_id, u.diagnosis_sequence
      ORDER BY u.source_priority, u.source_diagnosis_code
    ) AS pk_rn
  FROM unioned u
)
SELECT

  sha2(concat_ws('|',
    'CCLF_D0284',
    d.source_claim_id,

    d.source_diagnosis_code,
    coalesce(d.source_diagnosis_code_system, ''),
    coalesce(d.diagnosis_type, ''),

  cast(null AS string)                                                      AS updated_by,
  current_timestamp()                                                       AS updated_at,

  cast(true AS boolean)                                                     AS is_active,
  d.source_claim_id,
